dedupe_keys.name: py crackdb pavement crack dataset from paraguayan roads

description: PY-CrackDB is a small image dataset of asphalt pavement cracks from national routes near Coronel Oviedo in Paraguay, built to train computer vision models that use road context. It has 569 images of 351 by 500 pixels, 369 with cracks and 200 without, and stresses fine fissures under 3 millimetres wide, which Paraguayan standards treat as important for early maintenance. The authors, Fredy Ramirez Villanueva, Jose Luis Vazquez Noguera and colleagues, published it with a data article on the CONACYT repository on 12 September 2025. Files are a database of about 46 MB and a 1.7 MB article, free to download under CC BY-NC 4.0, so commercial use is excluded. Coverage is a few road sections in one department. Caveats: the sample is small, labels mark crack presence and the licence is non-commercial. For simulation, it supports road condition modelling, capacity planning and asset management studies that need labelled crack imagery from a region rarely covered by pavement datasets. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
